_comment: Real example, instantiated over a critical-flow domain (a critical-flow domain): v1 module boundaries for lib/dep_boundaries.py. It is not that project's real audit boundary (that lives in its own ARCH-001..006 doc): it is the version a script can evaluate today, over the folders declared below. Each node's package prefixes are DERIVED by scanning 'package X' at run time (see deps.json:derived_prefixes) and are frozen here only as a design reference. Copy this file to config/dep-boundaries.json (or pass --config to lib/dep_boundaries.py) if your project has a similar shape: a pure domain/data core, a booking module with api/runtime/vendor/host, and an Android app with ui/framework/di.
node_dir_note: app-other is the app module's root folder, which is why it acts as a catch-all: any file under app-ui/app-framework/app-di escapes it because those paths are more specific (the longer folder prefix wins).
